apps.name: AthleteOS Recorder
apps.localizedDescription: Raw Polar H10 overnight recorder. AthleteOS performs all analysis and coaching.

versions.localizedDescription: Hardens morning RR recovery for persistent Polar SDK error 2/3 by rebuilding the Polar BLE API session, reconnecting from clean SDK state, verifying stored-file access, and trying both the H10 peripheral UUID and Polar device ID before fetch. Delivered through a verified GitHub Release asset.
